name: Dr. Deaa Bataineh
biography: Deputy Director of the Center of Excellence for Innovative Projects and Professor of Design and Innovative Strategies at Jordan University of Science and Technology, where he co-founded the design department. He holds a PhD in Design from the Institute of Design.
selected_affiliations_or_recognition: UNDP; European Union; UN Global Compact; National Designer of Jordan; Core77 Design Awards

name: Dr. Gjoko Muratovski
biography: Award-winning designer and innovation consultant across government advisory, higher education, and industry. Chief Innovation Officer at ICONA Design Group and previously the inaugural Ullman Endowed Chair and Director of the Ullman School of Design.
selected_affiliations_or_recognition: European Commission; Stanford SEED; Oxford Digital Leaders Network; White House Presidential Innovation Fellows
